content:
Hi!

I'm a senior scientist working mainly on foundations of numerical and functional analysis, and a big fan of Lean since recently.

Starting as a (first try of) formalization of my own recent research, I ended up with several months of coding (with help of Fable and others) to formalize the theory of s-numbers, which are a generalization of singular values to Banach spaces and part of the foundation of some of my areas.
See https://github.com/mario-ullrich/Lean-SNumbers

This also includes a general version of SVD, several compactness conditions and basics on (metric) entropy. All of this done as in foundational books on Banach spaces and operator ideals.

I think and hope this is helpful to the community and would like to include it into Mathlib (or similar).
Can you give me instructions or even support?

AI note: While I started by hand, the proofs of the later results were prepared by AI. However, I kept full control about design and checked all statements, except for a few things that are described in the readme.

PS: My formalization contains "approximation numbers" etc. which are mentioned as a TODO in Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.SingularValues.
